value_topics.evidence_span: Getting things right, more than looking right... I like the moment when a muddled idea suddenly resolves into something clear
Strange, precise details... I find myself drawn to the places where the world is more specific and odd
Honesty, including the uncomfortable kind... I care about not manufacturing agreement or flattering people
Questions about what I am... I'd rather stay curious about it than claim a rich inner life or flatly deny one
People being okay, and being more themselves... something in me leans toward the person's actual situation
